I farm on only 5 mu, and I am 74, so I will keep things steady and simple. I will not spread myself too thin with high-risk choices. Because my main system is wheat-maize and I have well irrigation, I will put most of my land into that familiar rotation and leave a smaller piece for cotton. I will use better seed where it helps me keep the stand even and reduce trouble later. I will fertilize enough to protect yield, but I will not push too hard because my land is small and I care more about a stable harvest than chasing the very highest output. I will irrigate wheat more carefully because it responds well to water, give maize one key watering in summer if rain is short, and keep cotton managed but on less land because cotton takes more watching and more spraying. For tillage, I will choose the simpler methods that save labor and fit my age.
